title: Marietta S NDE 21000
content:
I was very young and my brothers and sisters (of which I have seven), all went up into the hayloft to play. They were not supposed to but did anyway. I wanted to go with them but they said I was too little and wouldn't let me go. They left the door open so they could check on me I guess. When they were playing, I climbed up the ladder, and then climbed in. I was standing in front of the door, and of course, it’s in the floor of a hayloft. I started toward them and they started to come and get me. They were fussing at me. So I started to back up, and by the time, they screamed at me to stop, I fell out backwards. I fell on my head and neck, and I've always had trouble with my neck since then. I was not in my body when they got down to me, because I was above them looking down. They thought I was unconscious or dead, but I wasn't. I was just watching them. But, I was ok and didn't get why all the excitement. I was there and safe, and I didn't like them being upset. But it is strange how I felt I still remember that after all these years and with me being so little. You wouldn't think I would. I knew there was someone with me. I felt them holding me, and they loved me even more then my family. The kids ran and got mom and dad. And I got back in my body by that time. I don't really remember anymore. My head hurt then.

arrival.other_being_detail: She reported: "I knew there was someone with me. I felt them holding me, and they loved me even more then my family."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell backward out of a hayloft door, landing on head/neck.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Unidentified loving presence felt holding her during the OBE.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred after the fall; she felt an unseen loving presence; then she returned to her body before her parents arrived.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She emphasized being very young yet clearly remembering being above her body and feeling held by a loving presence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was not in my body when they got down to me, because I was above them looking down." "I knew there was someone with me. I felt them holding me, and they loved me even more then my family."
